scenario: Reyes, a director of Vortex Inc., bought 1,000 shares of Vortex common stock on March 1 at $40 per share and sold all 1,000 shares on June 15 of the same year at $52 per share. No other Vortex transactions occurred.
policy: Section 16(b) short-swing profit rule: any profit realized by a corporate insider from a purchase and sale (or sale and purchase) of the company's equity securities within a period of less than six months must be disgorged to the company.
question: Must Reyes disgorge the profit from these matched transactions to Vortex?
